onset.Description: Seconds from the session clock origin.

event_id.Description: SKOS notation of the authoritative SSTIM session event type. Categorical: a value repeats whenever the same kind of occurrence happens again. Levels link each code to its SSTIM definition, and the HED map generates the interoperable annotation.

session-open.Description: Opens the session scope defined as Sstim-session.

playback-start.Description: Opens the delivery scope defined as Sstim-delivery.

playback-pause.Description: Closes the delivery scope without closing the session scope; elapsed session time continues while delivered time stops.

playback-resume.Description: Reopens the delivery scope after a pause while the session scope remains open.

sstim_event_id.Description: Local name of the sstim:SessionEvent occurrence this row was generated from. Joins the row to the source graph and to the manifest's crossArtifactIds; ADR 0025 decision 6.

event-open.Description: The session-open occurrence at 0.000 seconds on the session clock.

event-start.Description: The playback-start occurrence at 0.300 seconds on the session clock.

event-pause.Description: The playback-pause occurrence at 190.000 seconds on the session clock.

event-resume.Description: The playback-resume occurrence at 250.000 seconds on the session clock.

event-interrupt.Description: The session-interrupt occurrence at 400.000 seconds on the session clock.

sstim_hed_definitions.Description: HED definitions the event_id annotations reference. Not a column of events.tsv. Onset and Offset are scope tags requiring exactly one paired Def/, so the events do not validate without these in scope.

SstimDurationConvention.Description: duration is always n/a in this bundle. SSTIM session events are instantaneous timeline marks, and inventing a duration would assert a span the native record does not contain. This is a note, not a redefinition of the BIDS-required duration column.

SstimEndOfRecordingConvention.Description: The final session-complete or session-interrupt row is also the end of this recording. HED temporal processing keeps an Onset active through end-of-file when no later matching Offset exists. If delivery is still open, its Sstim-delivery scope therefore ends with the recording; no playback-stop row is invented because the native SSTIM timeline contains none.

SstimGeneratedAnnotationNote.Description: HED 8.4.0 annotations are assembled from the event_id HED level map rather than materialised in events.tsv. SSTIM is canonical and HED is derived, so the native columns are the ones to read.
